name: CompTIA Security+

fee.note: US list price for one Security+ voucher on CompTIA's store. Vouchers are country and currency specific, so the price differs by country. The same page lists a voucher with Retake Assurance at $579 and CertMaster bundles with a voucher from $593.

exam.format: Up to 90 multiple-choice and performance-based questions in 90 minutes. English only at launch. CompTIA recommends two years of hands-on experience as a security administrator; it is a recommendation, not a prerequisite.

scope: Core security work: security concepts and controls, threats and vulnerabilities (including AI-related risks), security architecture for cloud, hybrid and on-premises environments, security operations and incident response, and security governance, risk and compliance.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: SY0-801 (V8) launched on November 17, 2026, in English only. SY0-701 (V7) can still be taken until it retires: in English on June 11, 2027, and in Japanese, Portuguese, Spanish and Thai on August 13, 2027. Both have the same length, question cap and passing score, but the domains differ (V7: General Security Concepts 12%, Threats, Vulnerabilities, and Mitigations 22%, Security Architecture 18%, Security Operations 28%, Security Program Management and Oversight 20%). Buy the voucher for the version you will sit: CompTIA vouchers are exam series specific and sometimes exam code specific.

Renewal: the certification lasts three years. Renew with 50 CEUs plus a $150 CE fee per three-year cycle, by passing the latest version of the exam, through CertMaster CE, or with some higher-level CompTIA certifications.

access.retake: No wait between the first and second attempt; at least 14 days before the third and later ones. Every attempt is paid in full, unless you bought a voucher with Retake Assurance, which includes one retake.
access.accommodations: In a non-English-speaking country, taking the exam in English when there is no localized version gives 30 extra minutes (ESL), added automatically at Pearson VUE.

timeline.text: SY0-701 (V7) retires in English; SY0-801 (V8), launched November 17, 2026, is the current version.
SY0-701 (V7) retires in Japanese, Portuguese, Spanish and Thai. Until then V7 is the only Security+ exam offered in Spanish.
